title: Apply Impulse-Momentum Theorem
text: Impulse equals change in momentum: $$J = \Delta p = m(v_f - v_i)$$

title: Set Up the Equation
text: Since the object starts at rest ($$v_i = 0$$): $$30 = 2 \times (v_f - 0) = 2v_f$$

title: Solve for Final Velocity
text: $$v_f = \frac{30}{2} = 15$$ m/s in the direction of the applied force.
